report:
Reviewed the complete region_balance claim, its one ordinary implementation association in evidence.rs, and both ordinary associated tests. No TODO/N/A entries or deferred prerequisites exist.
Source assessment: index_source maintains a source-local opener stack; standalone comment closers pop it or emit an orphan-closer diagnostic, and remaining openers emit missing-closer diagnostics. The scanner obtains literal spans from Rust tokens and skips those spans before collecting comments, so string delimiters cannot open or close regions. Region end positions come from actual closing comments, independently of point-preview length. Only canonical {anchor} markers and standalone >> closers affect this stack; ANCHOR/ANCHOR_END excerpt comments are ignored, so canonical entries require no mdBook markers.
Test adequacy: unmatched_regions_fail_and_strings_or_trailing_comments_do_not_close_them asserts exactly one correctly attributed diagnostic for orphan closer, orphan opener, string fake closer and trailing-comment fake closer; its balanced-region/raw-string fake opener fixture asserts no diagnostics and only one implementation. mdbook_excerpt_markers_neither_define_nor_close_canonical_regions asserts unrelated unmatched excerpt markers create neither implementations nor errors, then asserts a canonical region containing excerpt markers spans the entire source past six lines, retains STILL_INSIDE, and ends at the canonical closer. These assertions detect premature closing by legacy markers, point-preview truncation, and literal-created regions. Captured fixture index and correspondence dispatch confirm the tests route source through the reviewed scanner.
Baseline verification: independently compared historical source arrays byte-for-byte with current files. The full test source matches exactly. The sole implementation delta adds the meta.reviews.decisions association comment above placeholder_status; region behavior is unchanged. Reassessed the supplied historical rationale against current complete claim, metadata, implementation and assertions rather than treating prior approval as sufficient.
Execution: personally ran review start, dependency review reads, baseline comparison, and review record; no behavioral tests or workspace build were run by this reviewer. The coordinator separately reports 321 passing sage-meta tests and a passing root build; these are reported baseline execution, not my execution. Source inspection finds all claim aspects accounted for and no required edits.
